note: Adapted from the species description of Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the alate is unknown and only the soldier is described; synonymy citations, distribution records and figure numbers are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule reddish brown; nasus slightly darker than head; antennae light brown; pronotum yellowish brown, anterior lobe slightly darker; legs brownish yellow; abdominal tergites light brown with a smoky tinge, darker than head. Posterior half of head with a pair of setae, nasus with 4 long setae and several short hairs; pronotal margins with a few hairs; abdominal tergites with a few hairs, the last 3 with long setae; sternites with short hairs and a few long setae. Head capsule pyriform (1.58–1.64 mm long including nasus, 1.0–1.06 mm long excluding nasus, 0.96–1.05 mm maximum width); in lateral view slightly depressed behind base of nasus; nasus pump faintly visible. Nasus short, subcylindrical. Antennae 13–14-segmented; with 13 segments segment 3 nearly twice as long as segment 2, with 14 segments segment 3 slightly shorter than segment 2. Mandibles vestigial, each with a short apical process. Pronotum saddle-shaped, neither anterior nor posterior margin notched, although the original author's figure shows a faint notch (0.20–0.24 mm long, 0.47–0.50 mm wide).
